target.statement: False positive rate of a Rational Bloom Filter with m=8192 bits and n=1000 elements, compared to standard Bloom filter, as shown in Figure 6 (top).

compute.basis: The experiment is a small Bloom filter simulation with m=8192 bits and n=1000 elements, requiring only a few seconds of CPU time; the main effort is writing the RBF code from scratch since no implementation is provided.

blockers: No code released for the Rational Bloom Filter or Variably-Sized Block Bloom Filter; only a link to a MurmurHash library is given.
The paper reports unexpected artifacts (local minima at integer k) that may be hard to reproduce exactly without the original implementation details.
title: Extending the Applicability of Bloom Filters by Relaxing their Parameter Constraints
